title: Tech Note: 4D Live Window JavaScript Part 2 – Injection
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates using the 4D Live Window plug-in's Web_JavaScriptExecute command to inject arbitrary JavaScript into locally or remotely loaded web pages displayed inside a 4D database window, a technique explicitly limited to Windows because Mac OS's WebKit-based browser layer was too unstable for the feature at the time. The 4D Live Window plug-in and 4D Web 2.0 Pack have long been discontinued, and the practice of scraping/reskinning third-party pages (like the 4D Knowledgebase) via injected script raises concerns that were already flagged in the note itself regarding third-party API licensing. The core technique — embedding a native browser control and manipulating its DOM/CSS via injected script — is conceptually similar to later embedded-webview approaches, but the specific plug-in, commands, and workflow described are entirely obsolete today.
related_updates: 4D Live Window and the 4D Web 2.0 Pack were discontinued and are not part of any current 4D product
Modern embedded web content in desktop/mobile apps typically uses standard OS webview components rather than a 4D-specific plug-in
Firebug itself was discontinued years ago in favor of built-in browser developer tools
